company.name: SurfSync Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
company.overview: SurfSync Infotech is a Noida-based team that builds AI tools, websites, mobile apps, and software for startups and enterprises. Its website describes work across India and internationally and states that it has delivered 250+ projects.
company.certification: The website states that SurfSync is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

services.name: AI & Automation
services.description: AI-powered tools, smart workflows, and chatbots to reduce repeated work and help customers faster.

services.name: Web Development
services.description: Modern websites and web apps, from an initial version to tools a team uses every day.

services.name: Mobile Development
services.description: iOS and Android applications. The website specifically mentions React Native and Flutter.

services.name: E-commerce & CMS
services.description: Online shops and CMS sites with safe payments. The published Drive Tribe Tyres story describes clear filters, a full product catalog, and checkout.

services.name: Cloud & DevOps
services.description: Cloud hosting and go-live support designed to grow with a product.

services.name: Enterprise IT Solutions
services.description: Enterprise software and digital transformation, including new screens that work alongside existing systems.

services.name: UI/UX Design
services.description: The website lists user-focused UI/UX design support.

services.name: Digital Marketing
services.description: SurfSync can discuss SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, lead generation, and digital marketing strategy. The channel mix, deliverables, and availability are confirmed with the team after understanding the business goals.

services.name: Logo & Brand Design
services.description: Logo and brand identity design requests can be discussed with the SurfSync team. The visual scope and deliverables are confirmed after discovery.

services.name: Shopify Development
services.description: Shopify store projects can be discussed, including storefront setup, product management, and payment gateway needs. The team confirms platform fit and exact scope for each project.

services.name: n8n Workflow Automation
services.description: n8n workflow and API integration requests can be discussed as part of AI and automation projects. The team confirms connector support and workflow feasibility for the systems involved.

services.name: WhatsApp Business API
services.description: The website lists official WhatsApp Business API for sales and support.

services.name: Analytics setup
services.description: The website lists analytics setup as an offering.

services.name: Training & Documentation
services.description: The website lists step-by-step guides and training/documentation for teams.

serviceScopeNotes.digitalMarketing: The assignment specifically requires the chatbot to cover SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, lead generation, and digital marketing strategies. The team must confirm channels, deliverables, and availability for each enquiry.
serviceScopeNotes.logoDesign: The assignment specifically requires logo-design enquiries. Confirm visual scope and deliverables with the team after discovery.
serviceScopeNotes.shopify: The assignment specifically requires Shopify enquiries. Confirm platform fit, supported integrations, and exact scope with the team.
serviceScopeNotes.n8n: The assignment specifically requires n8n workflow enquiries. Confirm connector support and workflow feasibility with the team.

integrations.description: SurfSync's Magento and Angular service pages describe backend APIs and integrations for payments, analytics, and messaging. The exact integration depends on the project.

publishedClientStories.name: Drive Tribe Tyres
publishedClientStories.description: A published client story describes an online tyre store with clear filters, a full product catalog, and checkout. The quoted client is Ameer Sohail.

publishedClientStories.name: Infocus Publications
publishedClientStories.description: A published testimonial says SurfSync built a website for Infocus Publications; the client praised its fit to their requirements and the team's communication. The quoted client is Shubham Sutar.

portfolio.note: Individual project pages in this chatbot summarize the published SurfSync client stories and link back to the official source. The official website does not publish a direct public URL for each client project.

process: SurfSync describes its process as Discover, Plan, Build, and Launch. It says it combines strategy, design, and engineering, with regular communication and training/documentation for teams.
pricing: The website does not publish project pricing. Costs depend on project requirements; ask the SurfSync team for a quote.
timeline: The website FAQ says a landing page may take 2–4 weeks and a full web or mobile app typically 8–16 weeks. Timelines depend on scope; SurfSync provides an estimate after discovery.
maintenance: The website says SurfSync stays with clients after go-live for fixes, updates, and the next version. Ask the team to confirm the support arrangements for a specific project.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Contact SurfSync at info@surfsyncinfotech.in or +91 9429694356 to discuss your requirements.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: The website FAQ says a landing page may take 2–4 weeks and a full web or mobile app typically 8–16 weeks. SurfSync provides an estimate after discovery.

faqs.question: Do you work with clients outside India?
faqs.answer: SurfSync says it works with clients across India and internationally.

faqs.question: What makes your SaaS platform different?
faqs.answer: The website names Swagat Suite, HRMS, Sales CRM, and PatronPing, but does not publish detailed product comparisons or differentiators.

faqs.question: Does SurfSync offer digital marketing?
faqs.answer: SurfSync can discuss SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, lead generation, and digital marketing strategy. The team confirms channel mix and deliverables after learning about your goals.
